title: List Users
description: Retrieve a list of users matching the supplied filter criteria

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: The application-specific ID you've given to a user

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address associated with a user

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: The nice-looking name for a user

parameters.name: is_identified
parameters.description: Whether or not a user is anonymous or identified

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: The token indicating the page of users to fetch. The same filter criteria should be supplied. This value should not be specified when requesting the first page of users.

parameters.name: include_schema
parameters.description: Whether to include schemas in the response.

uid.description: The application-specific ID you've given to the user

display_name.description: The nice-looking name for this user

email.description: The email address associated with this user

is_being_deleted.description: Indicates whether or not this user is in the process of being removed

properties.description:
Properties that provide additional information about your user.
 - Up to 500 unique properties are allowed.
 - Property names must be a sequence of alphanumeric characters A-Z, a-z, or 0-9 and underscores ("_").
 - Property names must start with an alphabetic character (A-Z or a-z).
 - The maximum property name length is 512 characters.
 - Property values may also contain nested objects. Properties within nested objects must still conform to the naming requirements. For nested objects, the property name including the dotted concatenation of all its parent properties must still be under the length limit of 512 characters.
 - Property values have a maximum size of 8192 bytes. If the value for the property is larger than this limit, the property will be rejected.

schema.description: A mapping from fields to their types, whether inferred automatically or declared in the request.

properties.description: A mapping of field names to their corresponding types.

type_conflicts.description: Any fields that are associated with multiple types.

properties.description: Any fields that are associated with multiple types.

app_url.description: A link to the Fullstory app segments page, focused on this user.

items.description: Server response payload for retrieving a single user

results.description: The list of users that match the input filter criteria

total_records.description: The total number of users that matched the filter criteria

next_page_token.description: The token that can be used in a subsequent request with the same filter criteria to fetch the next page of users

app_url.description: A link to an anonymous segment in the Fullstory app containing these users.

response.description: Server response for listing all users satisfying the request
